scripts.dev: concurrently -n web,api,palm -c cyan,green,magenta "npm run dev -w @nepal-hand-pay/web" "npm run dev -w @nepal-hand-pay/api" "npm run dev:palm"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @nepal-hand-pay/shared-types && npm run build -w @nepal-hand-pay/api && npm run build -w @nepal-hand-pay/web && npm run build -w @nepal-hand-pay/mobile
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @nepal-hand-pay/shared-types && npm run typecheck -w @nepal-hand-pay/api && npm run typecheck -w @nepal-hand-pay/web && npm run typecheck -w @nepal-hand-pay/mobile
scripts.test: npm run build -w @nepal-hand-pay/shared-types && npm run test -w @nepal-hand-pay/api && npm run test -w @nepal-hand-pay/web && npm run test -w @nepal-hand-pay/mobile
scripts.test:api: npm run build -w @nepal-hand-pay/shared-types && npm run test -w @nepal-hand-pay/api
scripts.test:integration: npm run build -w @nepal-hand-pay/shared-types && npm run test:integration -w @nepal-hand-pay/api
scripts.test:mobile: npm run build -w @nepal-hand-pay/shared-types && npm run test -w @nepal-hand-pay/mobile
